comments: Richard Skinner sits in for Tommy Vance: "Last week I went down with the flu and Tommy stood in for me on Rock On, this week I return the favour."
Tommy & Tony choose a track each in the latest instalment of the Staff Selection. Tommy - Pink Fairies. Tony - Allman Brothers.
The winner of this week's Friday Night Connection omitted to put their name but is from the Southampton area.

sessions.details: First broadcast of session recorded 28th January 1983. Paul Dennis (guitar/vox), Mark Bloxsidge (bass), Nick Szymanek (drums)
Repeat of sessions first broadcast 5th May 1968 (Top Gear) and 3rd August 1969 (Top Gear).
